items.text: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring during Wednesday's practice (Houston Chronicle). Missed five games on a hammy in 2024. Crucial MRI results expected tomorrow. Week 1 routes on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27.
items.why: Hamstring injury in practice; history of multi-week absence on same injury.
items.implication: Monitor MRI; potential multi-week absence opens targets for Hutchinson/Boutte.
items.opportunity: 37 routes Week 1 lead; high-volume WR1 role at risk.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, an indication he could return Sunday.
items.why: Full practice participation signals readiness post-ankle issue.
items.implication: Potential lead back return; monitor for snap share vs committee.
items.opportunity: Depth chart lead if cleared; handcuff value flips.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP Wednesday. Got mental reps and expects to play Sunday vs Texans.
items.why: Back tightness limited practice but player expects to play.
items.implication: Likely active; start with confidence pending Thursday/Friday.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring issue post-MNF; early-week DNP concerning.
items.implication: Monitor closely; potential absence elevates committee mates.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week after 49ers rookie WR De'Zhaun Stribling injury (IR/surgery). Berry highlights him on FFHH as #1 add with elevated opportunity.
items.why: Stribling IR (ankle surgery, out into Nov/Dec); Deebo saw 21% target share + 3 RZ targets in Week 1.
items.implication: Immediate WR3/flex upside in SF offense; priority FAAB claim.
items.opportunity: Role expansion via teammate absence; red-zone usage.

items.text: Ladd McConkey DNP Wednesday (rib injury from Week 1 hit). ETR lists Tre Harris as primary waiver beneficiary.
items.why: Rib injury; early DNP lowers confidence for Week 2 availability.
items.implication: Have backup ready; Tre Harris elevated if out.
items.opportunity: McConkey high-volume WR role at risk.

items.text: A.J. Brown on IR (high ankle). ETR Week 2 waivers list Romeo Doubs and DeMario Douglas as primary beneficiaries available on waivers.
items.why: High ankle sprain requires IR (min 4 games).
items.implication: Stash in IR; Doubs/Douglas immediate targets in NE.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3. Same knee had PCL sprain + bone bruise last year. Scary but day-to-day per coach.
items.why: Meniscus trim; coach hopeful, not overly serious per reports; DNP Wednesday.
items.implication: Monitor practice; TE1 upside if returns soon.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut as expected: handled 29 of first 32 RB opportunities, 19 routes on 33 Mahomes dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share). 23-173-1 rush, 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominant early-down + receiving role confirmed; full-grown-man usage.
items.implication: RB1 lock ROS; every-down back with receiving upside.
items.opportunity: 29/32 opps, high route/target share, goal-line implied.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty upgrades to high-end RB1: tied Bijan for #1 Utilization Score (99) in Week 1. 73% snaps, 70% rush attempts, 61% routes into 21% targets, 23 carries + 6 targets, 156 scrimmage yards + 2 TDs.
items.why: Every-down role with elite efficiency metrics post-OL upgrades; historical comps average 23.1 PPG.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1. He simply played a horrific game (xFP model based on targets/location/depth).
items.why: High opportunity (targets in good spots) but poor conversion; regression expected.
items.implication: Buy-low candidate; usage supports upside despite box score.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja’Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery to quicken recovery. Out four games. ETR beneficiaries: Rashod Bateman, Chris Moore.
Alvin Kamara injury beneficiary on ETR Week 2 waivers: Kendre Miller. (Kamara may return Week 2; Etienne saw diluted role in three-way backfield Week 1).
items.why: Kamara absence/possible limited return creates Miller opportunity; Etienne snap/attempt dilution noted.
items.implication: Miller stash/handcuff value; Etienne downgrade risk if Kamara back.
items.opportunity: Backfield role expansion on teammate status.

items.text: Rashee Rice career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 Week 1). Needs volume. Only 2 targets (7% share) but routes solid: 29 on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd behind Worthy 30).
items.why: High route participation but low aDOT/volume limits ceiling without more targets.
items.implication: Volume-dependent WR; watch for target share increase.
